audit_items.proof_trace: Every role category in syncRoles uses mutually exclusive conditions to populate rolesAssigned vs rolesRemoved: generation roles are disjoint by neq DB filter, team roles by set membership, leader and member roles by if/else on a single boolean/status value, status roles by an explicit `roleId !== targetStatusRoleId` guard in the removal loop, and verified roles are only ever assigned. Additionally, /api/roles/sync-all (rolesSyncAll.ts) does not include roles_assigned/roles_removed in its response at all.
